facts.business: Vision Corporation Limited operates in the movies and entertainment segment, engaged in production of movies, video and audio rights.

auditor.name: M/s. Bhasin Hota & Co.
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Material uncertainty related to going concern due to accumulated losses of ₹1,236.73 Lakhs, net loss of ₹67.44 Lakhs, and revenue decline to ₹25.59 Lakhs from ₹1,216.40 Lakhs.

key_risks: Competition from established producers and production houses
Global competition from animation and gaming companies in China, Korea, Philippines, Singapore with cost advantages and government subsidies
Scarcity of human capital with combination of creativity and technology skills
Lack of organized training centers and education channels for industry
Capital intensive industry requiring high-end systems and storage equipment
Higher cost of funds resulting in lower margins
Rapidly changing methods, software, and technology requiring continuous adaptation and training
facts.related_party_note: Advances to Related Parties disclosed under Other Current Assets (Note 12) but amount not specified.
